catches: $260 total for the Inspector route = $220 Election Day rate + one-time $40 stipend for completing all required training.

payout_quote:
## Inspector

Responsible for properly processing voters, issuing ballots, setup and breakdown of voter privacy booths and assisting the Clerk and Assistant Clerk with preparing the facility for voting, as well as cleaning up after the polls close. ... $220 Election Day / $15 per hour Early Voting. ... All positions are paid an additional one-time stipend of $40 for successfully completing all required training. To receive the stipend, you must work either Election Day or Early Voting.

steps: Meet Florida eligibility (registered voter in Lake County) and apply to the Lake County Supervisor of Elections to be appointed as an election worker.
Successfully complete all required online and in-person training sessions and assessments.
Work as an Inspector on Election Day (processing voters, issuing ballots, setup/breakdown of privacy booths, cleaning up after polls close).
Receive $220 Election Day pay plus the one-time $40 training stipend via direct deposit through the SOE's payroll site.
timing: Election Day, approximately 6 AM-8 PM (estimated 14 hours; polls in Florida are open 7 AM-7 PM by statute).
weasel_words: Election Day hours are not stated on the official page; 14-15 hours estimated from Florida's statutory 7 AM-7 PM poll hours plus setup/close.
Training is required (online and in-person) but its duration is not stated, so no time is counted for it.
Eligibility details are not on the pay page; registered-voter-in-Lake-County is the standard Florida requirement.
Early Voting ($15/hr Inspector) is a separate optional mechanism, not part of this route.
